```{r}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/probe_mapping/curated/probe_mapping_data.RDS",
  c(
    "reference_genome_summary",
    "reference_gene_summary",
    "partial_gene_summary",
    "amr_gene_coverage",
    "amr_reference_summary"
  )
)
```

```{r}
paste0("Reference genome coverage")
reference_genome_summary %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Reference genome gene coverage data: ")
reference_gene_summary %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Partial gene coverage: ")
partial_gene_summary %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Resistance genome data:")
amr_gene_coverage %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Summary data: ")
amr_reference_summary %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Focus on rRNA modelcules: ")
amr_gene_coverage %>%
  filter(reference_locus %in% c("16S_rDNA", "23S_rDNA")) %>% arrange(reference_locus,-coverage_percent) %>% favorite_kable()
 
 amr_gene_coverage %>%
  filter(reference_locus %in% c("16S_rDNA", "23S_rDNA")) %>% group_by(reference_locus) %>%  summarise(coverage_percent_range = range(coverage_percent) %>% paste0(collapse='-'),
                                                                                                      coverage_bp_range = range(covered_bp)%>% paste0(collapse='-')) %>% favorite_kable()
```
